scenes.say: The twenty twenty-seven F1 grid is almost done. Just one seat out of twenty-two is still open.
McLaren: Norris and Piastri. Mercedes: Russell and Antonelli. Red Bull: Verstappen, signed to twenty thirty, with Hadjar.
Ferrari: Leclerc and Hamilton. Aston Martin: Alonso stays on with Stroll. Williams: Sainz and Albon.
Alpine: Gasly and Colapinto. Audi: Hulkenberg and Bortoleto. Racing Bulls kept Lawson and Lindblad.
Cadillac has just kept Bottas alongside Perez. Haas has Camara, and the other seat is open.
Reports name Oliver Bearman as favourite: Haas holds an option on his deal.
If Bearman stays, there's only one new face: Rafael Camara in for Esteban Ocon.

title: F1 2027 grid: 21 of 22 seats filled, one left at Haas
